payload.title: Adoption lead: propose native tasks.md support to oh-my-claudecode
payload.body:
Draft an issue for oh-my-claudecode (OMC) that proposes native TASKS.md support. Do not file it without the owner's yes: it is a public post. Keep the draft in docs/research/. Source idea: minsky task omc-tasksmd-issue; see https://github.com/fyodoriv/minsky/blob/main/TASKS.md.
- **Hypothesis**: one concrete upstream proposal brings at least one new tool that reads TASKS.md, raising the adopter count by 1.
- **Measurement**: gh issue list -R <omc repo> --search tasks.md (issue exists and gets a maintainer reply)
- **Success**: a maintainer replies within 30 days or the proposal is merged.
- **Pivot**: if there is no reply in 60 days, stop and try one other tool.
- **Anchor**: Rogers 2003, Diffusion of Innovations.
